name: Monograph (Press showcase)
description: A richly illustrated long-form document rendered as a docusite — numbered chapters with nested subsections, figures with captions, data-driven specimen and measurement tables, citestyle-formatted references, and compile-time options (figure inclusion, citation style, chapter toggles). The same JSX tree powers the themed web preview and a branded .docx with headers, footers, page numbers, and a table of contents. Ships with Charles Darwin's Galapagos observations as sample content.
